title: harness config
description: A project's settings for the am plugin's hooks (.harness.json).

guard.description: Extra commands for the guard to block, on top of its built-in rules.

pattern.description: A regular expression matched against the command text.

statusLine.description: Show the am plugin's status line in this project, set in .claude/settings.local.json. An object shows it too, and sets the percentages at which each bar turns yellow and red.

context.description: The context bar; yellow from 10, red from 15 by default.

fiveHour.description: The 5-hour bar; yellow from 50, red from 80 by default.

sevenDay.description: The 7-day bar; yellow from 80, red from 95 by default.

sessionReview.description: Review each finished conversation into .about/ with the glossary and adr skills. Without it, the review runs where .about/ exists.

gitHooks.description: Git hooks to generate: each runs its entries in order and stops at the first failure. A Git hook is installed only when its key is present.

command.description: A shell command; it gets the Git hook's arguments as $1… and, for pre-push, its stdin.

yellow.description: The percentage from which the bar is yellow.

red.description: The percentage from which the bar is red.
